description: Astro 6 notes site with React islands and the ClientRouter: in-place navigation between static pages, a zod-validated form island, a module store that islands on different pages share through useSyncExternalStore, notes persisted to localStorage, and a client:visible report island that reads them through a class with private fields and getters. Compiler-based: the .astro compiler regenerates code, so directives in .astro files need pre-compile capture, before the compiler discards the original source. This fixture builds in static (SSG) mode. Its pages show their content before the client:load islands hydrate, so the layout sets <main data-app-ready> once they have, and the smoke check and the scenarios wait for smoke.readySelector before they click.

build.note: obfuscation runs automatically via @afterpack/astro (a real Astro integration that injects @afterpack/vite's closeBundle hook through astro:config:setup) -- no separate step

interactions.description: React island hydrates via client:load; counter increments on click.
